verdict.rationale: Floot's own checkpoint feature lets you label a point in the project (create_checkpoint) and revert to it, or ask the assistant to restore a checkpoint. That gives project-wide versioning and rollback, which would include scheduled jobs. It is not specific to automations, and nothing shows a review step such as diffs or change history. missing for 10: automation-specific version history, review/diff of changes before or after applying, documented rollback scope for scheduled jobs, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations

citations.quote: create_checkpoint labels a point you can revert to from the Checkpoint panel in your project view.
Ask it to restore a checkpoint from before the change went sideways.
Jobs that run on a schedule, without a server to keep alive.
